Hi team,

Thanks for the ping — happy to take point on this. Below is what we can provide immediately and notes on full-report requests.

SOC 2:
- We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit (covers security, availability, confidentiality) — most recent report dated 2025-10-12. We can share the SOC 2 attestation (PDF) and a controls summary. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2025.pdf

Pen test / vulnerability management:
- High-level pen test summary: we have a redacted executive summary from the most recent third-party pen test (Q4 2025) that covers scope, key findings (redacted), and remediation status. Attached: PenTest_Summary_Q4-2025.pdf
- Full raw penetration test report: available under a standard confidentiality process (NDA + written attestation). If FinHealth requires the full report, we can execute a standard NDA and provide the report to Priya for review.
- Scanning cadence: authenticated internal + external scans monthly; weekly incremental scanning for active deployments when we roll changes to production.
- Triage and SLAs: Critical findings: initial acknowledgement within 24 hours, remediation plan within 72 hours; High: acknowledge within 48 hours, remediation plan within 7 days; Medium: remediation plan within 30 days.
- Disclosure: coordinated disclosure process with affected customers and a 90-day remediation window for most findings; exceptions handled case-by-case with documented mitigation.

Attachments I'm including for FinHealth:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (attestation)
- PenTest_Summary_Q4-2025.pdf (redacted summary)
- Vulnerability_Management_Policy.pdf (process + SLAs)

Related links / references: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/finhealth

If Priya needs the full pen test report, let us know and we'll share our NDA template and next steps. Otherwise, the three attachments and a short Q&A response to their questionnaire should cover procurement.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
